concepts.definition: ROE > ROA. Occurs when borrowing cost is less than property yield.

The process of paying off a debt with a fixed repayment schedule in regular installments over time.

questions.q: What is the primary driver of MBS value?
questions.a: The underlying cash flows from the pool of individual mortgages.
